claims.reason: The time limit for filing has expired.
claims.plain: SilverSummit says the claim came in too late. It did not: the clearinghouse accepted it on May 12, five days after the session. SilverSummit told us in July it had no record of it, so we sent it again on Sep 30, and that copy is what they denied as late.
claims.fix: Send a reconsideration with proof of timely filing: the May 12 acceptance report (277CA) and the Jul 15 call reference. Do it inside the 180 days to be safe.

claims.fix: Correct the Medicaid ID (EVS shows the right one) and resubmit today as a new claim. Psyflo now puts every front-end reject on this list the day it comes back.

claims.reason: Authorization absent · Level 2.1 IOP began before the ASAM level-of-care decision.
claims.plain: The client came to IOP on Sep 24 while the Level 2.1 request was still with SilverSummit. They approved it Sep 26, effective Sep 26. Level 2.1 is never backdated, so this day cannot be paid by the plan.
claims.fix: Not recoverable from SilverSummit. Check whether the client qualifies for SAPTA block-grant funding for that day; if not, write it off. Psyflo now flags IOP days on the roster that fall before a PA decision.

claims.reason: Non-covered: the plan does not pay for drug testing that tracks dimension 5 relapse risk.
claims.plain: Anthem does not pay for the urine drug screen (H0048) that tracks dimension 5 relapse risk. None of the Medicaid plans do, even the ones that now require the result.
claims.fix: Write it off and stop sending H0048 to Medicaid plans. Psyflo drops H0048 from claims and lists it for the SAPTA grant report instead.

claims.plain: R. Owens (new hire, CADC-I) is not on HPN's provider roster yet. Since the provider-type change every clinician bills under their own NPI, so HPN has nothing to match.
